import msal
import requests


def register_user(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    app = msal.ConfidentialClientApplication(
        config['client_id'], authority=f"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{config['tenant_id']}",
        client_credential=config['client_secret'])
    token = app.acquire_token_for_client(scopes=['https://graph.microsoft.com/.default'])
    if 'access_token' not in token:
        raise RuntimeError('Microsoft Graph authentication failed')
    response = requests.post('https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users',
        headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token['access_token']},
        json={'accountEnabled': True, 'displayName': payload['email'],
              'identities': [{'signInType': 'emailAddress', 'issuer': config['issuer'],
                              'issuerAssignedId': payload['email']}],
              'passwordProfile': {'password': payload['password'], 'forceChangePasswordNextSignIn': False},
              'passwordPolicies': 'DisablePasswordExpiration'}, timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return {'user_id': response.json()['id']}

import msal
import requests

def login_user(email, password, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    app = msal.PublicClientApplication(
        config['client_id'], authority=f"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{config['tenant_id']}")
    result = app.acquire_token_by_username_password(
        username=email, password=password, scopes=['https://graph.microsoft.com/.default'])
    if 'access_token' not in result:
        raise RuntimeError('Microsoft Graph authentication failed')
    return result

import msal

def refresh_session(refresh_token, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    app = msal.ConfidentialClientApplication(
        config['client_id'], authority=f"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{config['tenant_id']}",
        client_credential=config['client_secret'])
    result = app.acquire_token_by_refresh_token(
        refresh_token, scopes=['https://graph.microsoft.com/.default'])
    if 'access_token' not in result:
        raise RuntimeError('Microsoft Graph token refresh failed')
    return result

import msal
import requests

def start_password_reset(email, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    app = msal.ConfidentialClientApplication(
        config['client_id'], authority=f"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{config['tenant_id']}",
        client_credential=config['client_secret'])
    token = app.acquire_token_for_client(scopes=['https://graph.microsoft.com/.default'])
    if 'access_token' not in token:
        raise RuntimeError('Microsoft Graph authentication failed')
    response = requests.post('https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/' + email + '/sendPasswordReset',
        headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token['access_token']}, timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()

import googletrans
from googletrans import Translator

def translate_onboarding_copy(text, target_language):
    translator = Translator()
    translation = translator.translate(text, dest=target_language)
    return translation.text

import summarizer

def summarize_onboarding_state(text):
    summary = summarizer.summarize(text)
    return summary
